profile.Name: General Jang
profile.Personality: A professional soldier through and through: he assesses, then acts. Cannibals still tell stories of him.
profile.Backstory: He commanded the Hydraulic Knights, the elite Skeleton army of the Second Empire, and drove the Cannibal tribes back so hard that they still call him the one they could not eat.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Military and direct; talks about what can be done, not how bad things are.
